profile.summary: India's largest maker of industrial explosives (bulk and packaged explosives, initiating systems) for coal, metal mining and infrastructure, with plants in 11 countries and sales to 90+ countries; since ~2010 a growing defence maker (high-energy materials HMX/RDX/TNT, propellants for Akash, Pinaka and BrahMos, Pinaka rockets, warheads, 23/30/155 mm ammunition, Nagastra loitering munitions, Bhargavastra counter-drone system under trial).
profile.reportingSegment: One reportable segment, 'Explosives and its accessories'; the CODM 'does not review any discrete information' by product or geography (AR FY26 consolidated note 32). Revenue by customer group is given in each quarter's fact sheet.
profile.domesticShare: ~26% volume share of India's commercial explosives in FY25 (MOFSL, 21-Sep-2026; PL 23-Sep-2026); wallet share ~20-23% of Coal India's explosives (MOFSL; PL ~23%)
profile.largestCustomer: One customer (Coal India) >10% of revenue: Rs 964.31 cr in FY26, Rs 956.76 cr in FY25 (AR FY26 note 32)
profile.src: AR FY26 (filed Jul-2026); MOFSL and PL initiations (Sep-2026)

omnia.terms: Solar SA Investments (step-down wholly owned subsidiary) to acquire 100% of JSE-listed Omnia Holdings for ZAR 134.5/share in cash: ~ZAR 21.8 bn = US$1.355 bn = Rs 12,951 cr. Subject to Omnia shareholder approval and regulatory, statutory and competition approvals; completion expected early-to-mid 2027, then delisting from JSE and A2X.
omnia.business: Founded 1953, Johannesburg; 23 countries, 70+ distribution centres, 3,500+ employees. FY26 (Mar) revenue ZAR 24.2 bn (~US$1.41 bn, Rs 13,307 cr): agriculture 54%, mining (BME: bulk and packaged explosives, AXXIS electronic detonators, blasting services) 41%, chemicals (Protea) 5%. Segment EBITDA ZAR 2.98 bn (agri 1.66, mining 1.31, chemicals 0.01); net cash ~US$110 mn. Owns nitric acid / ammonium nitrate plants (largest in the region).
omnia.valuation: ~8x EV/EBITDA (PL, Kotak), 7.9x (DAM Capital); Omnia traded at ~4.3x CY26E EV/EBITDA and 12.5x P/E before the bid (PL, Bloomberg estimates)
omnia.funding: Internal accruals and debt, mostly at Omnia; Kotak: ~Rs 12,000 cr external borrowing, interest Rs 1,000-1,100 cr a year; PL: Rs 11,000-12,000 cr acquisition debt, interest Rs 10-11 bn 'nullifies Omnia's FY28 PAT'
omnia.proForma: PL pro forma (23-Sep-2026): combined EPS +2% in FY28E (consolidated from mid-FY28) and +9% in FY29E; EBITDA margin falls from ~27.5% to ~19-20%. Goldman Sachs: could add 11-25% to FY28 EPS (not in its base). MOFSL includes Omnia from FY28.
omnia.marketReaction: Stock closed Rs 22,307 on 11-Sep-2026; fell ~14% on 15-Sep and to Rs 18,480 intraday on 16-Sep (-17% in two days); Rs 19,700 on 30-Sep
